text:
marina: hey everyone, first day! my Okta invite says "organization mismatch" (marina@redwood.ai vs marina.personal@redwood.ai) and I can't finish 1Password setup. onboarding Drive folder is empty for me too. yubikey delivery delayed. who do I ping for alias fix or a quick unblock?
quentin-peopleops: welcome @marina :wave: sorry about that. looks like you have a secondary email on Google. I'm updating your Okta profile to the primary alias and reissuing the invite now. will also add a 1Password seat.
marina: thanks! is it possible to use a platform passkey meanwhile? my laptop supports passkeys and i'd prefer not to wait on the hardware.
quentin-peopleops: passkey is fine as a temporary MFA. i'll flip the org flag to allow passkeys for you. once you sign in to Okta, go to Security -> Add passkey. i'll DM a rotated temp password if something blocks enrollment.
lucy-sre: for repos we can add an SSH key or create a short-lived PAT. SSH is preferred. DM me your public key and i'll add you to the team org and onboarding repos. if you need a quick copy of commands:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "marina@redwood.ai"
# then paste ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
marina: sending pub key via DM. also 1Password shows "account not provisioned" right after sign-in. is that normal?
quentin-peopleops: 1Password seats sync from People Ops, once i add it should propagate within ~5 min. if you still see the error after 10m reply here and i'll escalate.
devops-bot: ticket #ONB-7892 opened for Okta alias + 1Password seat. assigned to people-ops. ETA 25m.
it-bot: automation: Okta invite resent to marina@redwood.ai at 2498765458.
marina: got the new invite, signed in, enrolled a platform passkey, but `op signin` still fails with "account not provisioned"  — will wait a few mins.
quentin-peopleops: seat added. try again in ~3 min. if `op signin` errors use `op account add --team-url https://redwood.1password.com` before signin (sometimes needed on initial provisioning).
marina: that did it! `op signin` succeeded and the onboarding Drive folder is visible. ssh clone worked too. thanks all :)
lucy-sre: welcome aboard @marina :tada: tip: if you hit SSO cookie loops, try incognito or clear cookies for accounts.google.com.
quentin-peopleops: shipped yubikey; tracking DM sent, but keep using passkey until it arrives. adding you to #eng and #onboarding. ping if anything else blocks.
it-bot: ONB-7892 resolved by people-ops at 2498765500."
